preserves: DEV2 private/COW baseline only; DEV3 replaces page-before-commit with WAL-before-page and persistent undo
same-major formats designated as compatibility baselines by version-compatibility-policy.json remain readable or convertible

invariants.rule: ACK requires a durable complete commit and every recovery/namespace dependency; DEV3 redo protects unflushed mutable pages; publication precedes ACK
One transaction changes DISK, all indexes, locator, membership and catalog atomically
Committed decisions and published views form a legal consecutive commit_seq prefix; LogPos is lane-local
Before commit attempt ABORT is possible; uncertain attempted commit is UNKNOWN and fences writers
DEV2 exact immutable checkpoint; DEV3 fuzzy capture-LSN ATT/DPT checkpoint and separate offline exact-C backup; durable CURRENT never rewinds WRITER

Reclaim only outside every required owner: DEV2 root closures; DEV3 checkpoint/DPT WAL floors, undo/rollback references, snapshot horizons and pending doublewrite; preserve old/new selection uncertainty
Recovery selects one complete generation, validates all commit dependencies, preserves ACK and rejects known required corruption

Recovery preserves source WAL, stabilizes adopted history, durably selects a discoverable recovery epoch before new CLR effects, and resumes safely after repeated faults; DEV3 home pages may change under WAL/doublewrite
Serializable validation covers preceding accepted changes, absence/range/unique/catalog conflicts; DEV3 default table-set validation and explicit ReadCommitted follow the disk owner contract

Extended restore/PITR/replication must retain the profile-specific full backup/WAL/namespace closure; root-only COW logs require referenced immutable objects, DEV3 physical redo requires an adequate base backup and full redo chain
Every earlier same-major checkpoint/WAL/backup designated by the central version policy remains readable or convertible; distribution applicability is owned by that policy
Queues, pins, decoding, recovery and disk caches have explicit budgets and observable backpressure

logging_levels.scope: Single inline redo/commit stream, serial coordinator
Parallel private encoding, bounded single-writer group commit
logging_levels.additional_prerequisite: separate fine-grained serializable validation design and tests before admitting multiple concurrent writers in a group

logging_levels.scope: Parallel payload lanes plus global commit journal and prefix publication
logging_levels.additional_prerequisite: L1 plus applicable multi-stream acceptance and version gates required by the central version policy

l2_order: reserve bounded resources and prepare private values
validate and merge against preceding accepted view
persist all payload and COW page dependencies including namespaces
append complete CommitGroup with ordered entries and exact dependency references
publish composite root for whole group
l0_inline_optimization: Payload and commit trailer may share one WAL file and one sync; DISK COW sync still precedes commit attempt

checkpoint.selection: synced files and manifest, then atomic CURRENT replace and parent directory sync under qualified filesystem contract
checkpoint.fallback: only with complete retained replay log and object closure to committed tip
checkpoint.l0_predecessor_traversal_stop: Only at the selected manifest-authenticated anchor segment after identity, offset and prefix digest verification; retain the whole anchor file
checkpoint.l0_fallback_reselection: After verifying and stabilizing the full fallback path, durably select it as current with no previous before RESUME; never register the damaged current as previous

retention.authority: synchronized owner/pin ledger with generation retire protocol

fault_model.checksum_failure_default: fail closed; never blanket tail truncation
fault_model.required_dependency_missing: startup error; never skip transaction or lane
fault_model.full_length_torn_tail: REJECT_CORRUPTION even for an unacknowledged final frame; never count as RECOVER_OK

backup.K5: complete checkpoint closure at C restored in empty owned environment
backup.extended_restore: commit groups + payload + all referenced COW objects through target
backup.K5_reanchor: Restore validated state C without source WAL; new timeline/base-q=C header, local manifest, CURRENT and WRITER are durable before opening; preserve original backup provenance and bytes

not_initially_supported: asynchronous non-durable ACK under normal success
arbitrary wall-clock PITR inside a commit group
vector-dependency logging without global commit sequence
open_before_implementation: L1/L2 leaf task DAG and performance profiles

review_addendum.existing_storage_and_logging_design_pres: DEV2 only; DEV3 superseded by DEV3-DESIGN-003
review_addendum.principle: Use established durability/recovery principles; preserve implementation boundaries without predesigning future algorithms
clarifications: Durably link accepted prior log end to the new writer epoch before new commits; verify recovery followed by new ACK and second crash
Fault acceptance includes full-length torn writes as well as truncated tails; no unqualified relaxation of corruption handling

scope: CURRENT-only checkpoint selection and GC ordering

review_addendum.import_note: Design obligations retained; prior source survey and small-model reports remain in the original workspace and are not XADB evidence.

recovery_stabilization.l0_baseline: Explicitly sync retained WAL and epoch metadata from the selected checkpoint anchor through accepted R; preserve source bytes and pins
recovery_stabilization.failure: REJECT_IO; no new WRITER selection, publication, admission or GC

storage_profile_scope.legacy_fields: DEV2 private/COW baseline and historical L1/L2 proposal unless explicitly overridden below
storage_profile_scope.dev3: DEV3-DESIGN-003; disk-storage-design.md is the owner; legacy COW fields are not DEV3 requirements

dev3_profile.atomicity: TxnStatus plus published commit frontier; no physical root-set replacement
dev3_profile.torn_page: selected pending-only doublewrite; sync image/control before home, home sync then durable retirement before slot reuse; immutable FILEMAP bootstrap; complete allocation-authorized INIT image plus retained subsequent WAL may reconstruct an uninitialized/new page; delta-only corruption repair forbidden
dev3_profile.checkpoint: capture LSN and consistent ATT/DPT/status under commit coordinator; analysis after capture; redo from min(capture,min recLSN)
dev3_profile.recovery_log_open: stabilize adopted prefix and namespaces, durably link/select recovery WRITER before first CLR and its home effects; admission stays closed
dev3_profile.normal_verification: WAL/control/required/touched pages; full integrity audit separate and mandatory with independent history in acceptance
dev3_profile.backup: offline admission drain, flush/sync all protected pages at C, copy complete allocated closure, restore fresh timeline without source WAL; authenticated baseLSN greater than every copied pageLSN
dev3_profile.retention: min current/previous redo floors, dirty recLSN, system work and external consumers; undo/status refs and pending DWB obey separate lifetimes
dev3_profile.legacy_L1_L2: not adopted for DEV3; require new storage-aware decision and qualification before implementation
